statement: For original Elite extended packets, xpad reads four paddle states from the original-specific location and maps them to BTN_GRIPR, BTN_GRIPR2, BTN_GRIPL and BTN_GRIPL2. It zeroes the source paddle byte when current and factory button mappings differ, to avoid reporting remapped paddles as independent buttons, even though four paddle capabilities remain advertised.

applicability.revision: Linux v7.3 original Elite packet type
applicability.scope: xpad.c:1165-1180, 2001-2005, 2166-2172. No claim of physical raw-packet accuracy or of a particular profile exposing paddles.
